description: This file is a test script for Git's read-tree functionality, performing a series of test cases including setup, various conflict and merge scenarios, and checks involving working trees, ignored files, symbolic links, and directory/file conflicts.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a descriptive message.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Runs a read-tree command expecting it to succeed, handling output and errors.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a read-tree command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link in the test environment.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the preceding command fails.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the system clock or simulates time passage (used in test environment).

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs, asserting they are the same.
